5. Rationale Justifving Use of Cited Statutory Authority. In accordance with FAR 6.302-2, Unusual and Compelling Urgency, the agency may use other than competitive procedures to limit the number of sources from which it solicits bids or proposals when: (1) an unusual and compelling urgency precludes full and open competition, and (2) delay in award of a contract would result in serious injmy, financial or other, to the Government. Here, a non-competitive contract to GSMA is the only way to avoid unacceptable delays and ensure protection of vital national security capabilities.
